name: Jazz, Gin and the Crash
description: Ten years of speakeasies, talking pictures, record flights and big money, from the end of the First World War to the Wall Street collapse.

checkpoints.name: After the war
checkpoints.note: The Weimar Republic and the Treaty of Versailles shape a shaken Europe, while in the United States women win the vote with the Nineteenth Amendment and Prohibition makes alcohol illegal. German hyperinflation wipes out savings.

checkpoints.name: New sounds, new stories
checkpoints.note: Joyce's Ulysses, the BBC, Time magazine and Gershwin's Rhapsody in Blue mark a new age, while Armstrong and Ellington bring jazz north and Nosferatu shows what film can do.

checkpoints.name: High spirits
checkpoints.note: Fitzgerald writes The Great Gatsby, the Scopes trial puts evolution in court, the New Yorker begins, Lindbergh flies the Atlantic, Metropolis shows a film future and The Jazz Singer brings sound to cinema.

checkpoints.name: The crash
checkpoints.note: Fleming finds penicillin and Mickey Mouse debuts, and the first Academy Awards are held. Then the Wall Street Crash of 1929 ends the boom and opens the Great Depression.
